desc: Night Fision's Pistol Optic Plates offer precision, durability, and value for shooters needing a mounting solution for their red dot sight. Crafted from premium 17-4 stainless steel and built to the tightest tolerances, these plates withstand harsh recoil and ensure a secure, accurate fit. The nitride coating provides extra protection, and each package includes extra screws and an installation tool for easy setup.
